items.title: Local failure under uniform strong convexity
items.note: local_failure_lower states the theorem existentially in the TeX order: F finite and strongly convex (EuclideanStrongConvexOn with some kappa > 0) with compact sublevels and unique nonsmooth minimizer 0; starts x_0^(l) -> 0 with H_0 = I and runs x^(l) converging to xbar_l != 0 with xbar_l -> 0, 0 not in the subdifferential at xbar_l, F(x_k^(l)) strictly decreasing to F(xbar_l) > F(0); differentiable queries and query norms tending to 0; for every 0 < c_1 <= 1/3, c_1 < c_2 < 1 the specified implementation produces these runs with lengths 1, 1/4, 1/16; F is the maximum of four globally C^{1,1}, uniformly strongly convex branches with globally Lipschitz gradients, the first three not twice differentiable at 0, and mu I <= grad^2 F <= L I at every twice-differentiable point. Before M45 the title read "Independent local failure with positive lower curvature".
